title: Limit distributions and bootstrap for smooth adapted Wasserstein distances
abstract: arXiv:2611.28468v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: In this paper, we provide limit theorems for the Gaussian-smoothed adapted Wasserstein distances. Let $\widehat{\mu}_n$ be the empirical measure of independent paths with law $\mu$ on $(\mathbb{R}^d)^T$. Let $P = \mu * \gamma_\sigma$ and $P_n = \widehat{\mu}_n * \gamma_\sigma$, where $\gamma_\sigma = N(0,\sigma^2 I_{dT})$ is a Gaussian measure with mean zero and covariance matrix $\sigma^2 I_{dT}$. We first assume that $\mu$ is compactly supported. For every $1 < p < \infty$ and fixed $d, T$, and $\sigma > 0$, we show that $\sqrt{n}\,\mathrm{AW}_p(P_n,P) \Rightarrow Q_{P,p}(G)^{1/p}$, where $G$ is the Gaussian limit of the density fluctuation and $Q_{P,p}$ is the minimum adapted $p$-energy for the linearized continuity equation. We prove full-path bootstrap consistency and the convergence of the first and $p$-th moments. translated_title: 平滑适应Wasserstein距离的极限分布与自助法
translated_abstract: 本文给出了高斯平滑适应Wasserstein距离的极限定理。设 $\widehat{\mu}_n$ 是在 $(\mathbb{R}^d)^T$ 上服从分布 $\mu$ 的独立路径的经验测度。设 $P = \mu * \gamma_\sigma$ 和 $P_n = \widehat{\mu}_n * \gamma_\sigma$，其中 $\gamma_\sigma = N(0,\sigma^2 I_{dT})$ 是均值为零、协方差矩阵为 $\sigma^2 I_{dT}$ 的高斯测度。我们首先假设 $\mu$ 具有紧支撑。对于每个 $1 < p < \infty$ 以及固定的 $d, T$ 和 $\sigma > 0$，我们证明 $\sqrt{n}\,\mathrm{AW}_p(P_n,P) \Rightarrow Q_{P,p}(G)^{1/p}$，其中 $G$ 是密度波动的Gaussian极限，$Q_{P,p}$ 是线性化连续性方程的最小适应 $p$-能量。我们证明了全路径自助法的一致性以及一阶矩和 $p$ 阶矩的收敛性。该极限结果和自助法对非紧支撑的分布同样成立，在适当的尾部条件下对所有 $1 < p < \infty$ 均有效。
tldr: 本文首次建立了高斯平滑适应Wasserstein距离的√n速率极限定理，给出了由线性化连续性方程最小适应p-能量刻画的显式Gaussian极限分布，并证明了全路径自助法的一致性。
en_tdlr: This paper establishes √n-rate limit theorems for Gaussian-smoothed adapted Wasserstein distances, characterized by the minimum adapted p-energy of the linearized continuity equation, and proves full-path bootstrap consistency.
